cpu_contract: Process affinity restricted to 16 logical CPUs; BLAS threads 1, data loaders 0, scorer processes 4. Initial Zarr pools had excess idle OS threads; corrected nested configuration is retained with the original measurements.

gpu_budget.accounting: Charged GPU lease wall time, including CPU work under lease. Conservative pre-ledger resource-wall charges and interrupted upper bounds are identified separately. An interrupted lease charged through the next host boot can include downtime; its exact end was not observed.
